\documentclass[aspectratio=169]{beamer}
\usetheme{Madrid}

\title{Overlay conformance}
\date{}

\begin{document}

\begin{frame}{Remove and reflow}
  Prefix geometry \only<2>{a deliberately long inserted phrase that changes the
  paragraph's line breaking} suffix.
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Keep space}
  Always visible.

  \uncover<2->{Covered material \(\frac{x}{2}\) keeps its place on the first page.}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Item projection}
  \begin{itemize}[<+->]
    \item First item
    \item Second item
    \item Third item
  \end{itemize}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Alternatives}
  \alt<2>{During}{Otherwise}.

  \temporal<2>{Before}{At}{After}.

  \invisible<2>{Visible except on the second page.}
\end{frame}

\begin{frame}{Pause counter}
  Before the pause.

  \pause
  After the first pause.

  \pause
  After the second pause.
\end{frame}

\end{document}
